name.description: Name is the unique identifier within its Kind namespace.

namespace.description:
Namespace scopes this resource within its Kind. 1.0 locks every write to
"" or "default" (enforced in ValidateNamespace); see api/v1/validation.go
for the removal pointer once namespaces open up post-1.0.

resourceVersion.description:
ResourceVersion is set by the server and incremented on every write. It
is currently a pure write-counter; optimistic-concurrency conflict
checking is a separate post-1.0 task.

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs used for selection and grouping.

annotations.description: Annotations are non-identifying metadata (e.g. human-readable hints).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is set by the server on first write.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is set by the server on every write.

ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta holds identity and classification metadata common to all resources.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion identifies the versioned schema this resource conforms to, e.g. "caravanserai/v1".

kind.description: Kind is the resource type, e.g. "Node", "Project".

Secret.title: Secret
Secret.description: Secret is a namespaced resource holding sensitive configuration (database passwords, API keys, webhook URLs) referenced by a Project's EnvVar.valueFrom.secretKeyRef.

SecretDataItem.description: SecretDataItem is a single key/value entry in a Secret.

data.description:
Data holds the secret's key/value pairs. Values are stored as plaintext
in the backend for 1.0 (a known limitation; the transport is secured by
Headscale and the backend moves to Infisical later).

SecretSpec.description: SecretSpec is the desired state of a Secret: a flat list of key/value pairs.

SecretStatus.description: SecretStatus is intentionally empty: Secrets have no lifecycle phases and no controller-observed state.
